dct_description_sm: This dataset provides comprehensive information about Licensed Early Learning and Childcare Facilities in New Brunswick. It includes essential details such as the region, district, license number, facility name, childcare site name, facility type (full-time, part-time, or home-based), and the facility address. Additionally, the dataset specifies the number of licensed spaces, including those for infants, preschool-aged children, and school-aged children. It also details the language of service, the operator ID and name, and whether the facility is designated. For spatial analysis and mapping purposes, latitude and longitude coordinates of each facility are included.
